transliteration: brāhma-kṣatriya-viśa-śūdrā viprotpannās tv anukramāt | catustridvyekabhāgena bhaveyus te yathākramam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: From the union of Brāhmaṇa with Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, and Śūdra women respectively, offspring are born in sequence as per varṇic alignment; they shall be constituted by one-fourth, one-third, and one-half proportions accordingly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious genetic alignment
Causation arises through sequential manifestation of dharma-saṁskāra
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by birth-proportionality
Restoration logic aligns individual capacity with cosmic order
Consciousness alignment depends on inherited dharmic potential
executable_legal_axioms: IF parent_A = Brāhmaṇa AND parent_B = Kṣatriya THEN child.dharmic_capacity = 0.75
IF parent_A = Brāhmaṇa AND parent_B = Vaiśya THEN child.dharmic_capacity = 0.66
IF parent_A = Brāhmaṇa AND parent_B = Śūdra THEN child.dharmic_capacity = 0.50
AXIOM: All varṇic offspring must undergo completion process aligned to their proportional dharmic capacity
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning lineage-based rights or duties, the Supreme Court shall apply proportionality derived from generative saṁskāra without recourse to punitive hierarchy. Responsibility thresholds correspond directly to inherent dharmic capacity assigned at birth.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that causality originates in conscious procreation; anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential unfolding of dharma-saṁskāra; proportional responsibility reflects natural inheritance rather than imposed judgment; non-punitive reality holds because consequence is merely completion of inherent structure.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate saṁskāra-realignment for incomplete dharmic expressions
Assign role-integrity protocols matching inherited capacity
Activate consciousness-resonance programs for harmonizing social function
Implement śuddhi processes where distortion of varṇic alignment occurs
final_declaration: This law proceeds solely from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam. Dharma stands restored through recognition of inherent capacity. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
